units.source_text: 夕雾对云居雁，也不能通信。

en.t: Yugiri could not even exchange letters with Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 他毕竟相信云居雁远胜于惟光的女儿，常常挂念她。

en.t: After all, he believed Kumoi no Kari was far superior to Koremitsu's daughter, and he often thought of her.

units.source_text: 别离越久，相思之情越发难堪。

en.t: The longer they were apart, the harder his longing became to bear.

units.source_text: 天天悲叹不得再见一面。

en.t: Every day he grieved that he could not see her even once more.

units.source_text: 外祖母那里，也无心去访问。

en.t: He had no heart even to visit his grandmother's residence.

units.source_text: 想起了云居雁所住的房间，以及年来共处时的游钓之地，越发觉得深可恋慕。

en.t: When he remembered the room where Kumoi no Kari had lived, and the places where they had played and fished together over the years, his yearning grew still deeper.

units.source_text: 连这从小住惯的整个太君宫邸，也勾起他相思之苦。

en.t: Even the whole mansion of the Grand Lady, where he had lived since childhood, stirred the pain of his longing.

units.source_text: 因此他又笼闭在东院的书房里了。

en.t: Because of this, he shut himself away again in the study of the east wing.
